item.title: Using C# 14 to build "Smart records" for config & settings models
item.description: Traditional config classes let properties be mutated anywhere and accept invalid values with no warning. This article shows how to use C# 14's new extension-block syntax with records to build "smart records" - immutable, self-validating configuration models for cleaner, safer ASP.NET Core apps. Link to article: https://blog.elmah.io/using-c-14-to-build-smart-records-for-config-settings-models/
